page.overview:
Who is Eternity?

Eternity also appears as a non-playable character in World Tour mode, utilizing Juri's fighting style when fought as an opponent.

Eternity is dark-skinned and has blue hair, and wears a blue blazer jacket with pink trim, black choker, hotpants and boots.
